samples.name: The Monophonic Monastery
samples.power: Limit your opponent to playing one single melodic line card per turn.
samples.lore: From 400 AD to the 14th century, surviving religious music was entirely monophonic vocal chant. Common-practice tonality didn't exist yet.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ink-wash Gothic. Subject: Stern monks in medieval scriptorium enforcing one-note singing. Mood: Austere silence.

samples.name: Gregorian Chant
samples.power: Hypnotize the arena, rendering all high-flying moves useless for two turns.
samples.lore: The most notable style of the Middle Ages; highly effective for pacifying crowds before polyphony ruined everything.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Illuminated manuscript cartoon. Subject: Raging badger mid-chant hypnotizing a packed medieval arena. Mood: Tranquil menace.

items.title: THE MOVE: A Field Guide to Managed Reactions

samples.name: The Manufactured Emergency
samples.power: Frames an existing condition as immediate and universal to justify a response not otherwise available.
samples.lore: The condition may predate the framing; the urgency is introduced when the response requires it.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Boar pressing red button, alarms everywhere. Mood: Theatrical urgency.

samples.name: The Invisible Threat
samples.power: Sustains alertness toward dangers whose evidence cannot be independently examined.
samples.lore: Vigilance is maintained for threats described as classified, structural, or too complex to summarize for a general audience.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Kayfabizarro sketch. Subject: Owl guard scanning empty horizon with tech binoculars. Mood: Tense absurdity.

samples.name: The Rib-Breaker
samples.power: THE FALL: Flip a coin. If heads, opponent loses 3 Ribs (HP).
samples.lore: He that escapes not without some shaky limb shall acquit him well.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: vintage wrestling poster. Subject: bear in Victorian wrestling stance. Mood: gleeful brutality.

samples.name: The Youngest Brother
samples.power: SPIRIT OF MY FATHER: Gain +1 Attack for every turn you have been losing.
samples.lore: The spirit of my father begins to mutiny against this servitude.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: storybook illustration. Subject: lion cub with boxing gloves looking defiant. Mood: determined hope.

samples.name: THE CITY INSIDE
samples.power: THE HOST. Play at start. The table defines the "Health" of the City. If the City falls, the game ends.
samples.lore: It has been running the civilization while you were busy thinking about other things. You are the other things.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: steampunk cutaway. Subject: rabbit cross-section revealing industrial cityscape. Mood: awe-struck.

samples.name: THE CITIZEN
samples.power: THE PERMEABLE SELF. You are a superorganism. +1 to all Rolls involving "Gut Instinct."
samples.lore: You have never once told this city what to do. It has never once asked your permission.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: comic surrealism. Subject: human torso with hydra of animals erupting from neck. Mood: chaotic harmony.

samples.name: Uncle FrizzleBob's Kayfabizarro Komik Kult Kards
samples.power: Smashes through the fourth wall to deliver epistemic sabotage directly to the prefrontal cortex.
samples.lore: The truth isn't hidden in textbooks—it's scribbled in the margins by the people they kicked out of the room.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink comics. Subject: cartoon rabbit bursting through brick wall, textbooks flying. Mood: gleeful chaos.

samples.name: The Rules of Engagement
samples.power: Dictates the mechanics: Cut on the dotted lines, build your deck, and trust no authority.
samples.lore: A game is just a reality you willingly consent to—choose yours carefully.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: instructional diagram, hand-drawn. Subject: giant scissors cutting dotted lines around rule text. Mood: subversive bureaucracy.

samples.name: The Fairground Ticket
samples.power: Declare everything in play symbolic and open to reinterpretation
samples.lore: You enter a space where nothing is literal
samples.artworkPrompt: Hand holding carnival ticket glowing entry portal messy fair

samples.name: Uncle FrizzleBob
samples.power: Frame tragedy as comedy and invite absurd reinterpretation
samples.lore: Nothing is sacred, everything is playable
samples.artworkPrompt: Chaotic rabbit host grinning carnival ringmaster surreal

samples.name: Jack "The Earnest" Worthing
samples.power: DUAL IDENTITY — Flip a coin. Heads: You are Jack (Boring). Tails: You are Ernest (Fun). Gain +1 Momentum when lying to Gwendolen.
samples.lore: Found in a handbag at Victoria Station. Knows nothing. Wants everything. Pretends to have a wicked brother to escape the country.
samples.artworkPrompt: Anxious anthropomorphic rabbit in Victorian suit holding top hat nervously. Style: Victorian engraving. Subject: dual-identity gentleman. Mood: panicked elegance.

samples.name: Algy "The Bunburyist" Moncrieff
samples.power: BUNBURYING. Play this card to immediately escape any awkward scene. (Excuse: "I must visit my sick friend Bunbury").
samples.lore: Lives for pleasure. Eats for sorrow. Plays the piano inaccurately but with wonderful expression.
samples.artworkPrompt: Debonair anthropomorphic fox lounging on chaise with champagne and empty plates. Style: Victorian illustration. Subject: aristocratic hedonist. Mood: gleeful irresponsibility.

samples.name: The Blanket of Innocence
samples.power: Block 1 attack, but permanently reduce your Max Health.
samples.lore: The illusion of safety only delays the beating. Innocence must be sacrificed to gain wisdom. To refuse is to remain a victim.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink-wash cartoon. Subject: small puppy hiding under torn blanket while giant bear looms. Mood: false security.

samples.name: The Shield of Blame
samples.power: Shift damage to a teammate. Gain +1 Cowardice.
samples.lore: Moral weakness demands you refuse responsibility. Maturation demands you look in the mirror.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: ink-wash cartoon. Subject: opossum pointing frantically at teammate while referee watches. Mood: defensive deflection.

samples.name: 9/11 Trillions: Follow The Kayfabe-Money!
samples.power: Play this to instantly discard the "Official Narrative" card from play.
samples.lore: Uncle FrizzleBob's epistemic sabotage expansion! No humans, no neutrality, just pure analog financial wrestling!
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Pulp conspiracy poster. Subject: FrizzleBob rabbit tearing a dollar bill in half. Mood: Furious glee.

samples.name: Rule #1: Follow the Money
samples.power: Force your opponent to reveal their hand. Steal all cards with a 'Profit' value.
samples.lore: "It determines how we proceed with our investigation. 9/11 was a crime, and detectives must identify the perpetrators."
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Noir detective illustration. Subject: Bloodhound in trenchcoat sniffing a trail of gold coins. Mood: Relentless certainty.

samples.name: Uncle FrizzleBob & Lou
samples.power: PLAY: Ask the player to your left if they are ready to investigate themselves.
samples.lore: IDEA: If you write the rules of the game, you literally cannot lose.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: vintage investigative cartoon. Subject: rabbit and bear duo at interrogation table. Mood: conspiratorial warmth.

samples.name: The Ten Certificates
samples.power: PLAY: Slam your hand on the table and declare NOTHING WRONG!
samples.lore: IDEA: A certificate of innocence is best signed by the accused.
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: bureaucratic satire ink wash. Subject: wall covered in self-signed certificates. Mood: smug authority.

items.title: The Pharaoh Script — Psychology of Evil

samples.name: Secret History Vol. 06
samples.power: Play to reveal the invisible architecture of your own mind.
samples.lore: First there was the Mother Goddess. Then came the Polytheistic vibration matrix. Now? You worship the Literal Brain-Box. You've been downgraded.
samples.artworkPrompt: Watercolor. Uncut sheet glowing under all-seeing pyramid eye. Mood: revelation.

samples.name: Professor FrizzleBob's
samples.power: Equip to gain +10 Epistemic Sabotage.
samples.lore: School is hard because it teaches you to ignore your intuition and trust the data. FrizzleBob is hard because he teaches you the data is a psy-op.
samples.artworkPrompt: Pen-and-ink. Frantic rabbit professor at chalkboard labeled PSY-OP. Mood: manic authority.

samples.name: GILGAMESH "THE KING"
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Ancient Near East carved relief. Subject: Massive lion-headed king flexing. Mood: Unstoppable.

samples.name: ENKIDU "THE BEAST"
samples.artworkPrompt: Style: Mesopotamian stele engraving. Subject: Buffalo-headed feral warrior. Mood: Untamed rage.

items.title: Power Pyramid Plumbing & Global Psyop Wrestling – Expansion Deck 01

samples.name: Cecil's Diamond Trust
samples.power: Soft-Power Philanthropy. Extract 3 Wealth from all players; rebrand it as a 'Scholarship.' Opponents lose 1 Free Will.
samples.lore: The original architect of soft-power imperialism, buying the world's education to launder resources and rewrite the map in Union Jack red.
samples.artworkPrompt: Victorian rhino in top hat dispensing scholarships from blood-soaked diamond bags. Style: colonial satirical illustration. Mood: smug imperialism.

samples.name: Milner's Round Table
samples.power: Bureaucratic Necromancy. Spawn 3 NGO Tokens in enemy territories. Regime change occurs in 2 turns.
samples.lore: The Rhodes-funded kindergarten that realized conquering nations with armies is messy, but conquering them with advisory boards is highly profitable.
samples.artworkPrompt: Circle of fox-headed bureaucrats at round table, NGO flags replacing empire flags. Style: grotesque political cartoon. Mood: genteel predation.
